sections.title: Section 1: Job Inquiry
sections.html:
Vacant

(adjective). trống, rỗng

The seat next to him was vacant.

Sort

(noun). thứ, loại, hạng

What sorts of cameras do you sell?

Interfere

(verb). gây trở ngại, quấy rầy

I wish my mother would stop interfering and let me make my own decisions.

Work permit

(noun). giấy phép lao động

All foreigners need a work permit in order to get a job in Vietnam.

Branch

(noun). chi nhánh

McDonald's has branches all over the world.

branch

(noun). nhành cây

The tree has many big branches.

Recruit

(verb). tuyển chọn

I want to recruit some new employees.

Offer

(verb). lời đề nghị

The mentor offered some useful advice.

Hostel

(noun). nhà trọ

We stayed at a student hostel during the conference.

Fringe

(noun). phụ, ngoài

These people live on the fringes of society.

Perk

(noun). bổng lộc

This job comes with many benefits and perks.

Quality

(noun). chất lượng

The soil here is of poor quality.

qualification

(noun). bằng cấp, chứng nhận đủ khả năng

We believe that you have all the qualifications for this job, so we want to welcome you to our company.

quantity

(noun). số lượng

When it comes to ideas, quality is better than quantity.

Interview

(noun). phỏng vấn

They are doing an interview for the sales position.

Particular

(adjective). riêng biệt, ngoại lệ

this is a particular book I like

advert

(noun). quảng cáo

They enjoy the advert.

sponsor

(verb). tài trợ

The World Bank has sponsored several conferences on open government and freedom of information.

sponsorship

(noun). sự tài trợ

We received sponsorship from the company.

censorship

(noun). sự kiểm duyệt

The government has imposed strict censorship on the press.

Detail

(noun). chi tiết

He had an eye for detail

Find out

(verb). tìm ra

He's trying to find out the truth behind this mystery.

Work out

(verb). phát triển tốt

My first job didn't work out.

Work out

(verb). tập luyện

I work out regularly to keep fit.

Benefit

(noun). lợi ích

Doing exercise can bring many benefits

Look forward

(verb). mong đợi

I'm looking forward to my success.

sections.title: Section 2: Sports World
sections.html:
Attract

(verb). thu hút

The Effiel Tower attracts a lot of tourists.

attractive

(adjective). hấp dẫn

Many people find that money is very attractive.

attraction

(noun). điểm đến thu hút

The Effiel Tower is the most popular tourist attraction in Paris.

Customers

(noun). khách hàng

This restaurant has a lot of customers.

Original

(adjective). nguyên thủy, nguyên bản

This is an original painting by Picasso

origin

(noun). nguồn gốc

The origin of the world remains unknown.

Equipment

(noun). thiết bị

The hospital has modern equipment

Fixture

(noun). vật cố định

The price of the house includes lighting fixtures.

Ultimate

(adjective). cuối cùng

Silk sheets are the ultimate luxury.

Retail

(noun). việc bán lẻ

Walmart is the giant in the retail industry.

Minimalist

(adjective). thuộc về tối giản

Many people are following minimalist style of living

minimize

(verb). tối giản hóa

You should do everything you can to minimize the risk to your business.

Signature

(noun). ký hiệu

We just need you to put your signature here.

sign

(verb). ký

You should always check the contract carefully before signing.

Stock

(noun). hàng dự trữ

I'm sorry, but we have sold out those products and don't have any more in stock.

Claim

(verb). thỉnh cầu, yêu sách, tuyên bố (mặc dù không rõ tính xác thực)

Kylie Jenner claims that she is a billionaire.

Range

(noun). phạm vi, lĩnh vực

The buffet offers a wide range of food to customers.

Exist

(verb). tồn tại, hiện có

The unicorn does not exist

existence

(noun). sự tồn tại

I believe in the existence of God

Section

(noun). chỗ cắt, phần

That section of the road is still closed.

Autograph

(noun). chữ ký riêng của 1 người

Taylor Swift is being asked for autograph by her fans.

Competition

(noun). cuộc thi

He won the running competition.

compete

(verb). thi đua, đối đầu

Pepsi competes with Coca Cola on the market

Membership

(noun). tư cách hội viên

I have to renew my gym membership every month.

Fitness

(noun). người đẹp, cân đối

I've been going to the gym every day this week to improve my fitness and get into shape.

resistance

(noun). sự kháng cự

I'm on a diet so I need to have resistance against chocolate.

training

(noun). huấn luyện, dạy dỗ

New employees usually need training.

cardiovascular

(adjective). thuộc về tim mạch, hệ tim mạch

Stress can lead to serious cardiovascular diseases.

Cardiac

(adjective). thuộc về tim

Eating disorder can cause cardiac failure.

Staff

(noun). cán bộ, nhân viên

All the staff must wear uniforms.

sections.title: Section 3: Course Feedback
sections.html:
Cardiac

(adjective). thuộc về tim

Eating disorder can cause cardiac failure.

Staff

(noun). cán bộ, nhân viên

All the staff must wear uniforms.

Semester

(noun). học kì

A normal school year is usually divided into two semesters: the fall semester and the spring semester.

Presentation

(noun). bài thuyết trình

The presentation was too long.

Professional

(adjective). chuyên nghiệp

You should be professional during the interview.

Concentrate

(verb). tập trung

You need to concentrate on your studies.

Audience

(noun). khán giả

The audience was very excited

Approach

(noun). cách tiếp cận

She has a new teaching approach

approach

(verb). tiếp cận

His house is easy to approach

Frankly

(adverb). thẳng thắn

Frankly, I have never liked that girl.

Discussion

(noun). cuộc thảo luận

The discussion will start soon.

Confidence

(noun). sự tự tin

She speaks with confidence.

Colloquialism

(noun). lời nói khẩu ngữ

The more proficient we become in a language, the more colloquialisms we may use.

Tutorial

(noun). thời kì hướng dẫn

This tutorial is only open to a small number of students

tutor

(noun). thầy giáo kèm riêng

He has a math tutor.

Lecture

(noun). bài diễn thuyết của giáo viên

I had to attend a lecture this morning at 10 o'clock.

lecturer

(noun). người diễn thuyết

Obama is a superb lecturer.

Reference

(noun). sự hỏi ý kiến

She has a good reference from her previous boss.

Article

(noun). bài báo

I've read an article on fashion

Frustrated

(adjective). tức giận

She is frustrated.

Strategy

(noun). chiến lược

In a chess game, you can't just play without a strategy.

Psychological

(adjective). thuộc về tâm lý

Many young people are experiencing psychological disorders.

psychology

(noun). tâm lý học

Understanding psychology helps us to better understand ourselves and how we feel.

Motivate

(verb). thúc đẩy

my employer is the one who motivates me at work

Assignment

(noun). bài tập

You will need to complete written assignments every semester.

assign

(verb). giao bài tập, phân công, ấn định

The boss assigned the most difficult job to him.

Session

(noun). buổi họp

The information session was held online.

Occurrence

(noun). sự xuất hiện

Wall paintings used to be a rare occurrence here.

sections.title: Section 4: Mass Stranding Of Whales And Dolphins
sections.html:
Mass

(noun). khối, đống

She saw a large dark mass in the water.

Parasite

(noun). sinh vật sống ký sinh

Raw fish can contain parasites

Toxin

(noun). độc tố

The plants may contain some toxins

toxic

(adjective). độc hại

Water from that river is toxic.

Navigate

(verb). vượt biển, đi thông qua

How do you navigate your way through a forest?

navigation

(noun). sự điều hướng, sự chỉ đường

Many cars now have a built-in navigation system, also known as the GPS.

Ashore

(adverb). trên bờ

Whales are washed ashore on Bay Area Beach.

Infestation

(noun). sự tràn vào phá hoại

Infestation of horn flies on cattle may lead to serious skin problems

Potential

(adjective). tiềm năng

We have a lot of candidates applying for this job.

infest

(verb). tràn vào, quấy phá

The kitchen was infested with ants.

infect

(verb). lây

This virus will infect the whole area.

infected

(adjective). bị nhiễm, bị dính độc

His skin is infected.

Strand

(verb). mắc cạn

The boat was stranded many years ago.

Military

(adjective). thuộc quân đội

This area belongs to military force.

Pinpoint

(verb). xác định

This robot was able to pinpoint on the map the site of the medieval village.

emphasize

(verb). nhấn mạnh

We should emphasize the meaning of self-learning for each student.

emphasis

(noun). sự nhấn mạnh

Nowadays, a lot of emphasis is placed on being different from everyone else.

highlight

(verb). làm nổi bật, nhấn mạnh

Important information is highlighted in green.

coincidence

(noun). sự trùng hợp

By coincidence, they wear the same outfits

phenomenon

(noun). hiện tượng, sự việc kì lạ

Aurora, or the Northern Lights, is a natural phenomenon that sometimes happens in Northern Europe.

Assist

(verb). giúp đỡ, tương trợ

We tried to assist him.

assistance

(noun). sự giúp đỡ, sự hỗ trợ

Vietnam had a lot of technical assistance in WW2.

assistant

(noun). trợ lý

She hired a personal assistant to help her with her many tasks.

Theory

(noun). lý thuyết

The lesson contains lots of theories

Evidence

(noun). tính hiển nhiên

The fingerprints can be good evidence

Distinguish

(verb). phân biệt

It's hard to distinguish them because they are twins.

Inevitable

(adjective). không thể tránh khỏi

Growing old is inevitable

the inevitable

(noun). điều không thể tránh khỏi

You have to accept the inevitable: everyone will die.
